title: Cocycles and positive functionals in higher cohomology
summary: We establish and explore the correspondence between positive functionals and cocycles in higher unitary cohomology. We generalize the classical cocycle version of the Gelfand-Naimark-Segal construction to higher degrees and apply it to characterize vanishing of higher unitary cohomology as an extension property for positive functionals. We also prove that under mild conditions the algebraic spectral gap for the one sided Laplacian characterizes cohomological vanishing instead of reducedness of unitary cohomology
